common.about_rich:
Passionate about software architecture, I help businesses and technical teams stabilize their critical systems. Autonomy with clear communication: tickets, documented decisions, and pull requests; short meetings when it matters. Backend rigor so delivery stays predictable.

✅ I specialize in resilient systems: legacy to stabilize, APIs to consolidate, or quality to raise. Documented methodology from design to deployment, with performance work and E2E testing (Cypress, BDD) where it counts.
💻 Architecture & Backend: durable architectures (DDD, APIs, system integration) and targeted refactoring for maintainability.
🔌 APIs & Integration: API design and hardening, system interconnection, data consistency.
🔧 Technical debt & Performance: debt reduction, query optimization, caching strategies.
🧪 Quality & delivery: E2E testing (Cypress), BDD scenarios, CI/CD. Critical paths covered, regressions under control.
🌐 Infra & deployment: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD for controlled, reproducible environments.
💬 Let's discuss your next project: reliability, added value, or quality uplift.
common.aboutp1: Senior backend engineer focused on business-critical systems, APIs, and maintainable delivery. Autonomous, reliable, and clear in how I work with teams.
